column1: Whisk the honey, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, and lemon juice together. Set aside 1/4 cup for basting.
Toss the chicken with the remaining marinade and let it sit for 30 minutes.
Heat the grill to medium-high. Grill the chicken covered for 6–8 minutes per side until cooked through, basting with the reserved sauce during the last 5 minutes.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions if you like.
